text:
lara: quick note - bringing up the Apricot LoRA on rw-7b-int4 for a customer PoC. Ran a small smoke pack and saw inconsistent item extraction (sometimes inserts an extra tax line).

kevin: can you paste a failing example and the command you used?

lara: command: `rwi eval run --pack apricot-smoke --model rw-7b-int4 --seeds 0,7,42`
example (seed 7):
```
PROMPT: "List invoice items and unit prices"
OUT: "1) Widget X - $12\n2) Sales tax - $1.20\n(End)"
EXPECTED: "1) Widget X - $12"
```
only shows up in int4, int8 and fp16 clean.

sanjay: two quick checks: confirm tokenizer provenance and rerun with adapter tokenizer; and run a small token-occupation diff for the substring "Sales".

lara: ran `--tokenizer-path /mnt/finetunes/apricot/tokenizer.json` -> failure rate dropped but not gone. token-diff shows subtle id shifts for capitalized tokens.

eval-bot: eval job 2026-03-20_0912 completed: apricot-smoke seeds=0,7,42 -> failures on seed 7 only. logs at /artifacts/apricot/seed7.log

kevin: try switching GPTQ flavor: `--gptq per_channel=true,symmetric=true,bits=4` and re-run seeds. if that stabilizes it's likely quant mapping.

lara: re-ran with per_channel+symmetric: all seeds clean. looks like int4 asymmetric quant was amplifying small logits that map to punctuation tokens and create extra line tokens.

nora: action items: 1) add an anchor test to apricot-smoke that asserts no extra tax/service lines across seeds 0/7/42; 2) update model card recommending GPTQ per_channel+symmetric for rw-7b-int4 when used with Apricot LoRA; 3) add a quick tokenizer provenance step to the onboarding README.

sanjay: +1. also add a small CI util `rwi util token-diff` invocation after finetune unpack to catch tokenizer drift early.

lara: filed AP-460 with attached logs and PRs: apricot-smoke/test:invoice-anchor, docs: model-card-update, ci: token-diff-hook. tagging @kevin @sanjay @nora. :white_check_mark:
